name: Terraform
description: Terraform by HashiCorp is the industry standard Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool. Using the HCL (HashiCorp Configuration Language), it lets you define, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure across all major providers.

items.title: Terraform: Up & Running (Free Chapters)
items.description: The gold-standard book for learning Terraform — free chapter samples cover HCL, state, and modules.

items.title: HashiCorp Learn Terraform
items.description: Official hands-on tutorials with browser-hosted terminal sessions from basics to advanced.

items.title: Terraform Documentation
items.description: Complete Terraform reference covering CLI, configuration, providers, and state management.

items.title: Terraform Registry
items.description: Searchable catalog of thousands of providers and modules for cloud infrastructure.

items.title: HCL Specification
items.description: The HCL syntax specification and language design guide.

items.description: Browser-based Terraform terminal exercises for hands-on practice.

items.title: Terraform Commands Cheatsheet
